builds.howItPlays: You play units and spells that Stun enemy units, which stops them dealing combat damage that turn, and every time you Stun, Leona gives one of your units a +1 Might buff that stays. Nami, Headstrong (3 cost) Stuns an enemy unit when you pay an extra Calm rune for her, and Back Off (3 cost) Stuns a unit and draws you a card, so your side wins the fights on the battlefields you need.
builds.whyYou: You like fights you can see coming, and you like it when one card does two jobs. Every Stun here stops an enemy unit and grows one of yours. You enjoy the timing calls this deck asks for: whether to use Back Off now or hide it face down for a rune so you can play it for free on your opponent's turn, which unit gets Leona's buff, and when to spend that buff to play Call to Glory (+3 Might this turn) for nothing. Luck rarely decides it, because the deck is full of cheap tricks and cards that draw you another. If winning one battlefield at a time by outsmarting the other player's attacks sounds fun, this Leona suits you.
builds.ratingNotes: Changed 2026-09-25 (re-rate from the deck picks, style "Fiora Stun Leona"). The label stays Midrange. Coordinates moved from 2.5/3/6.5/4 to 5.5/5.5/7/3.5 (pace/stance/complexity/variance), the mean of three scored decks from tools.ts style. Pace moved 3 and stance 2.5. The old numbers came from quotes in the riftbound.gg and riftstorm.gg guides, not from scored lists. deckListUrl was the bare /decks page and is now Stun Sisters, the style's first deck. I dropped the riftbound.gg and riftstorm.gg guideUrls because I did not re-read them in this pass to confirm they describe this list. The three scored deck pages replace them. The old copy described the same stun-and-buff plan, so howItPlays and whyYou keep its idea but now name cards and no longer call the deck slow. Scored decks: LEONA SET 4 - Stun Sisters (Connor Lewis; 1 like, 586 views, pre-ban) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/d964ddfe-8925-4781-98dd-1c803af3ffa0 Midrange 5/5.5/7/3. Leonaaa (Álvaro Pinilla Veiga; 1 like, pre-ban) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/c8380c88-c90f-4940-9f8d-7b4465f2144c Midrange 5.5/5.5/7/3.5. Get stunned by Leona (skully; guide, edited 2026-09-23 after the ban) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/dee917ff-f4a4-4b81-b409-1f184a90ca9f Midrange 6/5.5/7/3.5. Mean 5.5/5.5/7/3.5; labels Midrange x3. The scorer suggested Tempo for all three because they run 18 to 19 reactive cards at Pace 5 or more. The raters judged Midrange: the guides call it stun-midrange, and the lists have only 6 to 8 units costing 2 or less. Adjustments: complexity +0.5 on all three, because the Legend turns every stun into a buff and Call to Glory (and Monastery in skully's list) spends buffs, so stun timing drives the whole deck. Variance -0.5 on Stun Sisters (all three battlefields draw on conquer or hold) and on Leonaaa (Monastery and Grove draw on conquer or hold). Cards that decided each Axis. Pace: 6 to 8 cheap units (Lonely Poro, Mournful Witness, Scuttle Crab) against 5 to 6 cards costing 5+ (Vi, Peacekeeper, Irelia, Fervent, Vex, Mocking, Leona, Zealot). Stance: 15 to 17 pressure cards against 12 to 13 answers (Back Off, Zenith Blade, Charm, Defy, Zhonya's Hourglass), so the balance sits near zero. Complexity: 17 to 22 cards that need planning, such as Hidden Back Off and Kennen, Nami's extra-cost Stun, Call to Glory's buff spend and Fiora's 5-Might threshold. Variance: full playsets, 12 to 13 cards that draw or find cards, and no luck cards. Legend ability: when you stun one or more enemy units, buff a friendly unit (+1 Might if it has no buff). Also played: Zhonya's Stun Leona https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/919e0e38-9c2c-4a60-852e-ca3e0c664835 (LianYadoran guide, 5/5/7.5/3.5), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/9228344e-5388-4177-853f-cf3048da7165 (5.5/5/7.5/3), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/62ab7a0e-fe99-41bd-bb6c-e2ac36867faa (6/5.5/7/4), which swaps Nami, Lonely Poro and Irelia for Zhonya's Hourglass, Mournful Witness, Affectionate Poro and Emperor's Divide. Movement Leona https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/aa96c907-7a93-459d-b62c-086b09cec2c0 (Rifeli's full guide, 38 likes, 5.5/6/7.5/5), a gear-and-movement plan with Forgotten Signpost and Leona, Determined. Sona Heron Leona https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/8c4832dd-f9a8-42a8-a08e-f7c2d6b49965 (EJequalsLast, post-ban, 4.5/4.5/7/4.5), which ramps into Astral Heron. Confidence: medium. Nine decks from nine authors, but only skully's scored list postdates the 2026-09-18 ban, and the strong result that clears the bar (Hartford RQ Best of Leona) is illegal because of The Arena's Greatest, a battlefield outside the style's core. Reviewer should check: the Los Angeles RQ (2026-09-25 to 27) will bring the first post-ban tournament Leona lists and may justify a rerun. Nobody checked for a starter deck in this pass.
